_comment: What nodemon may restart for, and — the point of this file — what not.
Without it nodemon watches everything under backend/, and the server
writes into two of those folders while it runs: every logged line in
logs/ and every uploaded file in uploads/ restarted it. In the middle
of an upload that is a request the browser never gets an answer to, and
a test run, which logs thousands of lines, holds the server down for as
Restarts belong to source changes. Nothing here is a source change.
